annotation.bound_parties_text: Argo Medical Technologies and persons who intend to market powered exoskeleton devices must comply with the special controls, general controls and submit a premarket notification before marketing.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: persons who intend to market this device type must submit a premarket notification containing information on the Powered Exoskeleton they intend to market prior to marketing the device
annotation.dates_quote: As a result of this order, you may immediately market your device as described in the de novo request
annotation.robot_provision_quote: This order, therefore, classifies the ReWalk™, and substantially equivalent devices of this generic type, into class II under the generic name, Powered Exoskeleton.
